title: Count the Seeds
story: Chilaka counts seeds out loud, one at a time, from 1 up to however many there are.
goal: Read n and print the numbers 1 to n, one per line.
starter:
n = int(input())
# print 1, 2, 3 ... n, each on its own line
hints: A for loop repeats a block: for i in range(...): (indented lines).
range(1, n) stops before n. How can you make it include n?

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    print(i)
socratic: Which numbers does range(1, 4) give you?
How do you make the loop include n itself?
What variable holds the current number inside the loop?
explain: In one sentence: why did we write n + 1?
alt:
n = int(input())
i = 1
while i <= n:
    print(i)
    i += 1

example.title: Worked example: count to 3
example.note: range(1, 4) gives 1, 2, 3. The end is not included.
